blocks.text: Hozirgi va o'tgan zamonlar: bitta tizim

1–18-darslarda zamonlar birma-bir, juft-juft qilib o'tildi. Bu ilova ularni bitta jadvalga yig'adi. Ingliz zamoni ikki qismdan iborat: **vaqt** (hozir yoki o'tmish) va **ko'rinish** (simple, continuous, perfect, perfect continuous). 2 × 4 = sakkizta shakl hosil bo'ladi. Muhimi: har bir ko'rinishning ma'nosi hozirda ham, o'tmishda ham **bir xil**. Shuning uchun Present Perfect ni tushungan odam Past Perfect ni ham tushunadi: faqat «qarash nuqtasi» hozirdan o'tmishga suriladi.
Jadvalni chapdan o'ngga emas, **yuqoridan pastga** o'qing: ko'rinish nimani bildirishini bilsangiz, vaqtni qo'shish oson. Har bir ko'rinish bitta savolga javob beradi:

rows: Ayni o'sha paytda nima bo'layotgan edi?
oldinroq bo'lgan harakat va uning keyingi paytga aloqasi
shu paytgacha davom etib kelgan faoliyat
Qancha vaqtdan beri davom etyapti / etgan edi?
hozir yoki shu kunlarda davom etyapti, vaqtinchalik
o'tmishdagi harakat, natijasi hozir muhim; vaqt aytilmaydi
Present Perfect Continuous (hozirgi tugallangan davomli zamon) → 9–10-darslar
hozirgacha davom etib kelgan faoliyat (qancha vaqtdan beri)

items.text: He **is repairing** my phone right now.
He **has repaired** it — it works perfectly.
He **has been repairing** phones since he was fifteen.
items.translation: U o'n besh yoshidan beri telefon **ta'mirlab keladi**.

rows: o'tmishdagi paytda davom etayotgan harakat, fon
We **were packing** when the taxi came.
The taxi **had left** before we got outside.
Past Perfect Continuous (o'tgan tugallangan davomli zamon) → 16-dars
o'tmishdagi paytgacha davom etib kelgan faoliyat
We **had been waiting** for an hour.

items.text: Nilufar **baked** a cake for her mother's birthday.
She **was baking** when her sister phoned.
items.translation: Singlisi qo'ng'iroq qilganda u tort **pishirayotgan edi**.

items.text: By noon she **had baked** two cakes and a tray of biscuits.
items.translation: Tushgacha u ikkita tort va bir patnis pechenye **pishirib bo'lgan edi**.

items.text: Her hands were covered in flour because she **had been baking** all morning.
items.translation: Qo'llari unga belanib ketgan edi, chunki u ertalabdan beri **pishiriq qilayotgan edi**.

blocks.text: Hikoya, xotira yoki o'zlashtirma gapda (→ 47–48-darslar) vaziyat o'tmishga ko'chadi va har bir zamon bir qadam orqaga suriladi. Ma'no mantiqi saqlanadi: hozirgi natija → o'tmishdagi natija, hozirgacha davom etgan faoliyat → o'sha paytgacha davom etgan faoliyat. Past Simple esa ko'pincha Past Perfect ga o'tadi, agar u boshqa o'tgan voqeadan **oldin** bo'lgan bo'lsa.

rows: The baby **is sleeping**, so be quiet.
The baby **was sleeping**, so we were quiet.
I can't open the door — I**'ve lost** my key.
I couldn't open the door — I**'d lost** my key.
I'm hot because I**'ve been running**.
I was hot because I**'d been running**.
He says he **left** at six. (o'tgan voqea)
He said he **had left** at six. (o'tgan voqeadan oldingi)
I **work** in a bank, but I**'m working** at home today.
I **lost** it last year. / I**'ve lost** it — help!
I**'ve written** two emails. / I**'ve been writing** all day.
When I arrived, she **left**. / she **had left**.
I had done / I had been doing
He **had painted** the room. / He **had been painting**.
I did / I used to do
bir martalik ↔ o'tmishdagi odat, endi yo'q
I **played** chess yesterday. / I **used to play** chess.

blocks.text: Holat fe'llari (know, believe, belong, own, need, seem, mean, understand) davomli ko'rinishlarda deyarli ishlatilmaydi — bu Perfect Continuous ga ham tegishli (→ 4-dars). «I've been knowing him for years» emas, I**'ve known** him for years. «She had been owning the shop» emas, She **had owned** the shop.

items.text: I**'ve known** Rustam since we were children.
When she sold the shop, she **had owned** it for twenty years.
items.translation: Do'konni sotganida, u yigirma yildan beri unga **egalik qilib kelgan edi**.

items.text: This bag **belongs** to my sister, not to me.

blocks.text: O'zbek va ingliz zamonlari birma-bir mos kelmaydi. Bitta o'zbekcha shakl vaziyatga qarab ikki-uch xil ingliz zamoniga tarjima qilinadi. Tarjima qilganda shaklga emas, **ma'noga** qarang:

rows: Present Perfect Continuous (holat fe'lida — Present Perfect)
Ikki soatdan beri **kutyapman**. → I**'ve been waiting** for two hours.
Kecha kalitimni **yo'qotdim**. → I **lost** my key yesterday.
Past Continuous yoki Past Perfect Continuous
Bolaligimda ko'p **o'qirdim**. → I **used to read** a lot.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I am living here since 2010.» → I**'ve lived** / I**'ve been living** here since 2010 («...dan beri» — perfekt); «I have seen him yesterday.» → I **saw** him yesterday (aniq o'tgan vaqt bilan Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi); «When I came, she already left.» → she **had** already **left** (oldinroq bo'lgan voqea); «I've been knowing her for years.» → I**'ve known** her; «Yesterday I was go to the bazaar.» → I **went** («-yotgan edi» bo'lmasa, Past Continuous kerak emas); «How long are you working here?» → How long **have** you **been working** here?

Zamon tanlashning uch qadami: 1) Vaqt — hozirmi yoki o'tmish? 2) Harakat jarayon sifatida ko'rinyaptimi (continuous) yoki butun bir voqea sifatida (simple)? 3) Undan keyingi paytga — hozirga yoki o'tmishdagi boshqa voqeaga — bog'liqmi? Bog'liq bo'lsa, **have** qo'shing (perfect). Uchta javobni birlashtirsangiz, sakkiz zamondan biri chiqadi.

Bog'liq darslar: → 1–4-darslar (hozirgi zamonlar), 5–6 (o'tgan zamonlar), 7–14 (Present Perfect va uning juftlari), 15–16 (Past Perfect), 17 (have got), 18 (used to); kelasi zamon shakllari → 148-dars; majhul nisbatdagi shakllari → 42–44-darslar.

rows: I **had been cooking** — ...dan beri pishirayotgan edim

examples.title: **works** or **is working**? Present simple and continuous
examples.description: Present Simple — doimiy holat, odat, fakt; Present Continuous — hozir yoki shu kunlarda davom etayotgan, vaqtinchalik harakat. Ko'p gapda ikkalasi yonma-yon.

sentences.text: Nodira **teaches** maths at a lyceum, but this term she**'s working** at the ministry.
sentences.translation: Nodira litseyda matematikadan **dars beradi**, lekin bu chorakda vazirlikda **ishlayapti**.

sentences.text: Why **are** you **wearing** a suit? You never **wear** one to the office.
sentences.translation: Nega kostyum **kiyib olgansan**? Ofisga hech qachon kostyum **kiymaysan**-ku.

sentences.text: My brother normally **drives** to work, but this week he**'s cycling** to save money.
sentences.translation: Akam odatda ishga mashinada **boradi**, lekin bu hafta pul tejash uchun velosipedda **qatnayapti**.

sentences.text: What **do** you **think** of the new manager? — I **don't know** her well yet.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer haqida qanday **fikrdasiz**? — Uni hali yaxshi **bilmayman**.

sentences.text: What **are** you **thinking** about, Shahzoda? You haven't touched your food.
sentences.translation: Nima haqida **o'ylayapsan**, Shahzoda? Ovqatingga qo'l ham tegizmading.

sentences.text: The sun **rises** in the east, but today it**'s hiding** behind thick clouds.
sentences.translation: Quyosh sharqdan **chiqadi**, lekin bugun qalin bulutlar ortida **berkinib turibdi**.

sentences.text: Online sales **are growing** fast, while traditional shops **are losing** customers.
sentences.translation: Onlayn savdo tez **o'syapti**, an'anaviy do'konlar esa xaridorlarni **yo'qotyapti**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **is always losing** his keys, and it drives me crazy!
sentences.translation: Bekzod doim kalitlarini **yo'qotib qo'yadi**, bu meni jinni qiladi!

sentences.text: I **don't usually eat** sugar, but I**'m having** a piece of cake because it's your birthday.
sentences.translation: Odatda shakar **yemayman**, lekin tug'ilgan kuning bo'lgani uchun bir bo'lak tort **yeyapman**.

sentences.text: This train normally **takes** two hours to Samarkand, but today it**'s running** late.
sentences.translation: Bu poyezd Samarqandga odatda ikki soatda **yetib boradi**, lekin bugun **kechikyapti**.

examples.title: **has done** or **has been doing**? Result or activity
examples.description: Present Perfect — natija yoki son (has read four novels); Present Perfect Continuous — hozirgacha davom etib kelgan faoliyat va uning izi (has been crying).

sentences.text: I**'ve been cleaning** the flat all morning, and I**'ve** only **finished** the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Ertalabdan beri uyni **tozalayapman**, faqat oshxonani **tugatdim**.

sentences.text: Your eyes are red and puffy. **Have** you **been crying**?
sentences.translation: Ko'zlaring qizarib, shishib ketibdi. **Yig'ladingmi**?

sentences.text: Madina **has read** four novels this month — she's a real bookworm.
sentences.translation: Madina bu oy to'rtta roman **o'qib chiqdi** — haqiqiy kitobxon.

sentences.text: How long **have** you **been learning** Japanese? — About two years.
sentences.translation: Yapon tilini qancha vaqtdan beri **o'rganyapsiz**? — Ikki yilcha bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Someone **has eaten** all the biscuits, and the box is empty!
sentences.translation: Kimdir hamma pechenyeni **yeb qo'yibdi**, quti bo'm-bo'sh!

sentences.text: It **has been raining** since Tuesday, so many roads are flooded.
sentences.translation: Seshanbadan beri yomg'ir **yog'yapti**, shuning uchun ko'p yo'llarni suv bosgan.

sentences.text: The company **has opened** three new branches in Bukhara since January.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya yanvardan beri Buxoroda uchta yangi filial **ochdi**.

sentences.text: We**'ve been trying** to call you for hours — where have you been?
sentences.translation: Bir necha soatdan beri senga qo'ng'iroq qilishga **urinyapmiz** — qayerda yurding?

sentences.text: How many times **have** you **been** to Samarkand? — Too many to count!
sentences.translation: Samarqandda necha marta **bo'lgansiz**? — Sanog'iga yetib bo'lmaydi!

sentences.text: Sorry about the mess — I**'ve been painting** the bedroom and **haven't cleaned** up yet.
sentences.translation: Tartibsizlik uchun uzr — yotoqxonani **bo'yayotgandim**, hali **yig'ishtirmadim**.

examples.title: Uzbek «...dan beri» = **have been doing** / **have done**
examples.description: O'zbekchadagi «...dan beri -yapman» va «... bo'ldi» inglizchada Present Simple yoki Continuous emas, Present Perfect (Continuous) bilan beriladi. Holat fe'llari (know, have, be) bilan — Present Perfect.

sentences.text: I**'ve been standing** at this bus stop in the cold for forty minutes!
sentences.translation: Qirq daqiqadan beri sovuqda shu bekatda **turibman**!

sentences.text: Akmal **has worked** at this hospital since 2015.
sentences.translation: Akmal 2015-yildan beri shu shifoxonada **ishlaydi**.

sentences.text: How long **have** you **known** Dilnoza? — Since we were at school together.
sentences.translation: Dilnozani qachondan beri **taniysiz**? — Maktabda birga o'qiganimizdan beri.

sentences.text: They**'ve had** that old Nexia for almost twenty years.
sentences.translation: O'sha eski Nexia ularda qariyb yigirma yildan beri **bor**.

sentences.text: We**'ve been living** in this neighbourhood since our daughter was born.
sentences.translation: Qizimiz tug'ilganidan beri shu mahallada **yashayapmiz**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **has been** ill for a week, so I**'ve been visiting** her every day.
sentences.translation: Buvim bir haftadan beri **kasal**, shuning uchun har kuni uning oldiga **borib turibman**.

sentences.text: Ten years **have passed** since we graduated, but it feels like yesterday.
sentences.translation: Bitirganimizga o'n yil **bo'ldi**, lekin xuddi kechagidek.

sentences.text: Why **haven't** you **called** me for so long? I was worried about you.
sentences.translation: Nega shuncha vaqtdan beri menga **qo'ng'iroq qilmading**? Sendan xavotir oldim.

sentences.text: Since the new road opened, the journey to Fergana **has become** much shorter.
sentences.translation: Yangi yo'l ochilganidan beri Farg'onagacha yo'l ancha **qisqardi**.

sentences.text: Sevara **has been studying** for her driving test since early morning.
sentences.translation: Sevara erta tongdan beri haydovchilik imtihoniga **tayyorlanyapti**.

examples.title: **was doing** and **did**: background and events
examples.description: Past Continuous — o'tmishdagi paytda davom etayotgan harakat, fon («-yotgan edi»); Past Simple — tugallangan voqea, ko'pincha fonni bo'ladi («-di»).

sentences.text: While I **was cooking** dinner, the lights suddenly **went** out.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat **pishirayotganimda** to'satdan chiroq **o'chib qoldi**.

sentences.text: At eight o'clock this morning we **were** still **sitting** in a traffic jam.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab soat sakkizda hali ham tirbandlikda **o'tirgan edik**.

sentences.text: Jamshid **was jogging** in the park when he **found** a wallet full of money.
sentences.translation: Jamshid parkda **yugurib yurganida** pulga to'la hamyon **topib oldi**.

sentences.text: Where **were** you **standing** when the fireworks **started**?
sentences.translation: Mushakbozlik **boshlanganda** qayerda **turgan edingiz**?

sentences.text: The sun **was shining** and birds **were singing** as we drove into the valley.
sentences.translation: Vodiyga kirib borayotganimizda quyosh **charaqlab turardi**, qushlar **sayrardi**.

sentences.text: I **wasn't listening**, so I **didn't hear** what the teacher said.
sentences.translation: **Quloq solmayotgan edim**, shuning uchun o'qituvchi nima deganini **eshitmadim**.

sentences.text: When Mum **came** home, we **were watching** TV, so we quickly **switched** it off.
sentences.translation: Oyim uyga **kelganda** biz televizor **ko'rayotgan edik**, shuning uchun uni tezda **o'chirdik**.

sentences.text: Emma **broke** her arm while she **was skiing** in Chimgan.
sentences.translation: Emma Chimyonda chang'i **uchayotganda** qo'lini **sindirib oldi**.

sentences.text: **Were** you **sleeping** when I rang? — No, I **was working** on my essay.
sentences.translation: Qo'ng'iroq qilganimda **uxlayotganmidingiz**? — Yo'q, inshoim ustida **ishlayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: As the plane **was landing**, a passenger **stood** up and **opened** the overhead locker.
sentences.translation: Samolyot **qo'nayotganda** bir yo'lovchi o'rnidan **turib**, tepadagi javonni **ochdi**.

examples.title: **did** or **have done**? Finished time or now
examples.description: Past Simple — tugagan vaqt (yesterday, in 2018, ago, when...); Present Perfect — vaqt aytilmaydi yoki davr hali tugamagan (today, this week, ever, yet), natija hozir muhim.

sentences.text: I**'ve lost** my passport — have you seen it anywhere?
sentences.translation: Pasportimni **yo'qotib qo'ydim** — biror joyda ko'rmadingmi?

sentences.text: I **lost** my passport in Istanbul two years ago and had to get a new one.
sentences.translation: Ikki yil oldin Istanbulda pasportimni **yo'qotganman**, yangisini olishga to'g'ri kelgan.

sentences.text: **Have** you ever **tried** horse meat? — Yes, I **tried** it at a wedding last summer.
sentences.translation: Hech ot go'shti **yeb ko'rganmisiz**? — Ha, o'tgan yozda bir to'yda **tatib ko'rdim**.

sentences.text: Shakespeare **wrote** dozens of plays, many of which are still performed today.
sentences.translation: Shekspir o'nlab pyesa **yozgan**, ularning ko'pi hozir ham sahnalashtiriladi.

sentences.text: Our teacher **has written** three textbooks, and she's working on a fourth.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz uchta darslik **yozgan**, hozir to'rtinchisi ustida ishlayapti.

sentences.text: **Did** you **see** the match last night? — No, and I **haven't seen** the highlights either.
sentences.translation: Kecha o'yinni **ko'rdingmi**? — Yo'q, hatto qisqa sharhini ham **ko'rmadim**.

sentences.text: Aziza **has been** really busy this week, but she **was** free last week.
sentences.translation: Bu hafta Aziza juda **band bo'ldi**, o'tgan hafta esa **bo'sh edi**.

sentences.text: When **did** you **move** to Tashkent? — In 2018, right after university.
sentences.translation: Toshkentga qachon **ko'chib kelgansiz**? — 2018-yilda, universitetdan keyin darhol.

sentences.text: The government **has announced** new rules for taxi drivers.
sentences.translation: Hukumat taksi haydovchilari uchun yangi qoidalarni **e'lon qildi**.

sentences.text: The minister **announced** them at a press conference on Monday morning.
sentences.translation: Vazir ularni dushanba kuni ertalab matbuot anjumanida **e'lon qildi**.

examples.title: **had done** and **had been doing**: the earlier past
examples.description: Past Perfect — o'tmishdagi paytdan oldin tugagan harakat («-gan edi»); Past Perfect Continuous — o'sha paytgacha davom etib kelgan faoliyat («...dan beri -yotgan edi»).

sentences.text: When we got to the cinema, the film **had** already **started**.
sentences.translation: Kinoteatrga yetib borganimizda film allaqachon **boshlangan edi**.

sentences.text: Lola was exhausted because she **had been working** in the garden since dawn.
sentences.translation: Lola holdan toygan edi, chunki tongdan beri bog'da **ishlayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Before I went to Batumi, I **had never seen** the sea.
sentences.translation: Batumiga borgunimcha dengizni hech qachon **ko'rmagan edim**.

sentences.text: The streets were wet because it **had been raining** all night.
sentences.translation: Ko'chalar ho'l edi, chunki tun bo'yi yomg'ir **yog'ib chiqqan edi**.

sentences.text: By the time the ambulance arrived, the man **had** already **lost** a lot of blood.
sentences.translation: Tez yordam kelguncha u odam allaqachon ko'p qon **yo'qotgan edi**.

sentences.text: How long **had** you **been living** in London when you met your wife?
sentences.translation: Xotiningiz bilan tanishganingizda Londonda qancha vaqtdan beri **yashayotgan edingiz**?

sentences.text: Sardor didn't come to the party because nobody **had invited** him.
sentences.translation: Sardor ziyofatga kelmadi, chunki uni hech kim **taklif qilmagan edi**.

sentences.text: Her eyes were red — she **had been crying** for hours.
sentences.translation: Uning ko'zlari qizarib ketgan edi — soatlab **yig'lagan edi**.

sentences.text: After the guests **had left**, we washed the dishes and collapsed on the sofa.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar **ketganidan keyin** idishlarni yuvdik va holdan toyib divanga cho'zildik.

sentences.text: The factory **had been losing** money for years before it finally closed in 2020.
sentences.translation: Zavod 2020-yilda nihoyat yopilgunga qadar yillar davomida zarar **ko'rib kelgan edi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: meeting an old friend
examples.description: Ko'p yillardan keyin uchrashgan ikki do'st: o'tmish, hozirgi hayot va shu paytgacha bo'lgan o'zgarishlar haqida — bir suhbatda turli zamonlar.

sentences.text: — Rustam? I **haven't seen** you for ages! What **are** you **doing** these days?
sentences.translation: — Rustam? Seni **ko'rmaganimga** ancha bo'ldi! Hozir nima **qilyapsan**?

sentences.text: — I**'m working** for a bank in Tashkent. I **moved** there three years ago.
sentences.translation: — Toshkentdagi bir bankda **ishlayapman**. U yerga uch yil oldin **ko'chib borganman**.

sentences.text: — Really? I **thought** you **were living** in Moscow.
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Men seni Moskvada **yashayapti deb o'ylagandim**.

sentences.text: — I **was**, but I **had been missing** home for a long time, so I came back.
sentences.translation: — **Yashayotgan edim**, lekin uzoq vaqtdan beri uyni **sog'inib yurgandim**, shuning uchun qaytdim.

sentences.text: — And what about you? **Are** you still **teaching** at the music school?
sentences.translation: — O'zing-chi? Hali ham musiqa maktabida **dars beryapsanmi**?

sentences.text: — No, I **left** last year. I**'ve opened** my own studio.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, o'tgan yili **ketdim**. O'zimning studiyamni **ochdim**.

sentences.text: — That's brilliant! How long **have** you **been running** it?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r-ku! Uni qancha vaqtdan beri **boshqaryapsan**?

sentences.text: — Only eight months, but we**'ve** already **had** more than fifty students.
sentences.translation: — Faqat sakkiz oy, lekin allaqachon ellikdan ortiq o'quvchimiz **bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: — I **was hoping** you'd say that! My daughter **has been asking** for piano lessons.
sentences.translation: — Shuni aytishingni **kutib turgandim**! Qizim ancha vaqtdan beri pianino darslarini **so'rab yuribdi**.

sentences.text: — Bring her on Saturday; I **usually give** trial lessons at ten.
sentences.translation: — Uni shanba kuni olib kel, odatda soat o'nda sinov darslari **o'tkazaman**.

examples.title: Mixed: news and stories in eight tenses
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: yangiliklar va hayotiy hikoyalarda zamonlar birgalikda. Har bir gapda zamon nima uchun tanlanganini aniqlang.

sentences.text: The museum, which **has been closed** for repairs since May, **reopens** next Monday.
sentences.translation: May oyidan beri ta'mir uchun **yopiq turgan** muzey kelasi dushanba **qayta ochiladi**.

sentences.text: Police say the thieves **had been planning** the robbery for months.
sentences.translation: Politsiya ma'lumotiga ko'ra, o'g'rilar talonchilikni oylar davomida **rejalashtirib kelgan**.

sentences.text: While the reporters **were waiting** outside, the minister **left** through a back door.
sentences.translation: Jurnalistlar tashqarida **kutib turganda** vazir orqa eshikdan **chiqib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Unemployment **has fallen** for the third month in a row.
sentences.translation: Ishsizlik ketma-ket uchinchi oy **kamaydi**.

sentences.text: My grandfather **worked** on the railway for forty years and still **talks** about it.
sentences.translation: Bobom temir yo'lda qirq yil **ishlagan** va hali ham bu haqda **gapirib yuradi**.

sentences.text: When the fire brigade finally turned up, the neighbours **had** already **put** out the flames.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilar nihoyat yetib kelganda, qo'shnilar olovni allaqachon **o'chirib bo'lishgan edi**.

sentences.text: Scientists **are** now **testing** a vaccine that they **have been developing** since 2021.
sentences.translation: Olimlar 2021-yildan beri **ishlab chiqayotgan** vaksinani hozir **sinovdan o'tkazishyapti**.

sentences.text: I **didn't recognise** Kamola at first because she**'d cut** her hair very short.
sentences.translation: Kamolani avvaliga **tanimadim**, chunki u sochini juda kalta **qirqtirgan edi**.

sentences.text: **Do** you **remember** the summer when we **were living** next door to each other?
sentences.translation: Qo'shni bo'lib **yashagan** yozimiz **esingdami**?

sentences.text: Since the new airport **opened**, the number of tourists **has doubled**.
sentences.translation: Yangi aeroport **ochilganidan beri** sayyohlar soni ikki baravar **oshdi**.
